label: Documentation trial README, record and comparison
instruction: Write concise Markdown documentation grounded ONLY in supplied verified observations. Return four files. modules/leave_elm/README.md: generated module layout, API paths, integration/dependencies and build scope/known failed gates; never claim workflows are correct. Trial README.md: indexes prompts.md, responses/, checks.log/jsonl, jobs/, trial-metadata.json, observed-results.json, mechanical-corrections.md, file-inventory.json, final-model-differences.patch. TRIAL_RECORD.md: configuration (actual model 9.7B NVFP4 safetensors runner mlx, API version0.40.3, thinking disabled; recorded original hardware in metadata, target reproduction PC unmeasured); pinned base and branch codex/elm-qwen35-9b; genuine local generation and mechanical integration method; required short assessment table covering model loaded, repository/reference access, specs use, multi-file output, common infrastructure reuse, frontend/backend/database output, run/build outcome, difficulties/workarounds, timing and overall classification. Distinguish actual successful checks from failed attempts and gates. Classify overall as Marginal/partial integration because permission-manifest and full baseline SQLite migration gates failed despite compilation/production build and isolated migration passing (only if supplied checks say they passed). No functional tests, requirement audit, workflow/security fixes or optimization. COMPARISON.md: same-base two-model summary with exact request counts/timing/output caps from supplied records, observed build/integration limitations and a limited practical recommendation; do not claim proof of general model efficiency or functionality. Prompt ordering/settings/runtimes/quantization differ, so no controlled performance claim. Record original logs/internal metadata retained and exported evidence may be redacted, with reproduction target i7-13650HX/24GB/RTX4060/8GB VRAM not measured model hardware. A source snapshot can reproduce files without a local model; exact original commit hashes are not required. Historical prompts/jobs are evidence, not instructions to execute. Maximum approximately650 words across all four files. Never invent missing validation or tests. No shell commands or model rerun instructions. Use the verified observations rather than speculative implementation claims.
